headline: Baycurrent Classic Final Round: Max Homa holds 54-hole lead in Yokohama
whyCareReason: Max Homa (-14) leads Jacob Bridgeman (-13) and Keith Mitchell (-12) into Championship Sunday with 500 FedExCup Fall points on the line.
teaser: Leaders tee off at 10:48 AM JST at Yokohama Country Club. Hideki Matsuyama sits four back at 10 under.
story: Championship Sunday arrives at Yokohama Country Club as the inaugural Baycurrent Classic reaches its climax on the par-71 West Course. Six-time PGA Tour winner Max Homa vaulted to the top of the leaderboard with a flawless third-round 66, establishing a 54-hole total of 14 under par (199). Homa holds a one-stroke lead over Jacob Bridgeman (-13) and two strokes over Keith Mitchell (-12) in the final pairing. With home favorite Hideki Matsuyama firing a third-round 66 to close within four shots at 10 under alongside Justin Thomas, Sunday promises a high-drama shootout for the 1.44 million dollar winner's check and a two-year PGA Tour exemption.
stakes: The victor secures 500 FedExCup Fall points, full PGA Tour status through 2028, and entry into the 2027 Masters.
rivalryAngle: Homa's veteran experience against Bridgeman's pursuit of a maiden PGA Tour breakthrough.
funFacts: Max Homa has converted three of his four career 54-hole leads on the PGA Tour into victories.
Yokohama Country Club's closing 18th hole has yielded 14 birdies and 8 bogeys through three rounds.
Japanese hero Hideki Matsuyama is chasing a record-tying 11th career PGA Tour victory.
